# sole-host

The `WarmupHost` host service (`infra/warmup`) of a host that is the only
backend on its machine — the browser composition and the portable boot test:
every scope runs (a `host`-scoped warm-up included — this host IS the host), and
there is no host-wide slot to take, so a body runs as is. The desktop provides
the service from `warmup#machine` (main-only `host` scope, the heavy-read slot);
this plugin is excluded from every desktop app by the composition config's
base-exclusions row (two providers of one service fail boot).

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Warm-up admission of a sole host — one backend with no neighbours (the browser composition, the portable boot test): provides the WarmupHost host service running every scope, host-scoped warm-ups included, with no slot to take. Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host-service:warmup.host` "warmup.host"
  - Uses: `infra/warmup.WarmupHost`
